description: Traffic lights — Sound signals for the visually impaired is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. This file contains the location of all traffic lights managed by the City of Montreal, at least one crossing of which is equipped with an acoustic light for the visually impaired.This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate). Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Accessibility, Traffic light, Sound fire, Traffic light, Intersection. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
